{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info
sales_df.info()

# Display first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display unique values in 'status' and 'order_type'
status_unique = sales_df['status'].unique()
type_unique = sales_df['order_type'].unique()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

(top_rows, status_unique, type_unique, missing_values)"}
